scope: Literature evidence for a concept/design manuscript. No numerical specification or alleged result from the earlier AI-written Zephyron paper is treated as empirical evidence.

sources.title: Redesign of rescue mobile robot Quince: Toward emergency response to the nuclear accident at Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station on March 2011
sources.venue: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Added mission hardware changed loading and stair behaviour; recovery provisions, operator interfaces and communication links required integrated redesign.
claims.locator: pp. 2–6; redesign, teleoperation and stairs sections

sources.limits: Emergency-response platform, not a controlled comparison or evidence that Zephyron can climb stairs.
sources.design_implication: Evaluate the combined payload, arm clearance, power recovery and operator workflow.

sources.title: A Search-and-Rescue Robot System for Remotely Sensing the Underground Coal Mine Environment
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Mine trials and responder training exposed wheel/track slip, trajectory deviation, relay/cable handling problems and requests for better camera coverage.

sources.limits: Reported tests apply to that mine robot and do not establish certification or performance for another rover.
sources.design_implication: Include cables, communications, visibility and responder usability in terrain tests.

sources.title: Lessons from robot‐assisted disaster response deployments by the German Rescue Robotics Center task force
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication
sources.reviewed_version: 2022 arXiv preprint of later journal article

claims.claim: Fire and flood deployments emphasize rehearsed teams, operator training and independence from unavailable local infrastructure.

sources.limits: The reviewed version predates the final journal article; some available robots were not used when trained operators were absent.
sources.design_implication: Define trained roles, offline procedures and mission abort/recovery arrangements.
sources.version_note: Journal issue year 2024; first online 6 December 2023. Evidence reviewed in 2022 arXiv preprint, not final publisher layout.

sources.title: Team CERBERUS Wins the DARPA Subterranean Challenge: Technical Overview and Lessons Learned
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Competition-scale field work combined heterogeneous platforms, multimodal perception, communications and supervised autonomy. Integration failures and degraded links remained consequential.

sources.limits: The lessons distinguish deployed single-robot autonomy from broader multi-robot coordination research; resources and hardware differ markedly from Zephyron.
sources.design_implication: Treat robust sensing and communications as system requirements rather than a single navigation algorithm.

sources.title: Semi-Autonomous Mobile Search and Rescue Robot for Radiation Disaster Scenarios
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Priority-based command selection combines autonomous navigation and teleoperation. Sampling uses operator-triggered routines; valve handling is teleoperated.

sources.limits: Width prevented entry to some rooms and outdoor mapping showed odometry drift; this is a preprint and not a Zephyron trial.
sources.design_implication: Provide explicit control authority, tool viewing and contamination-aware sample paths.

sources.title: Towards Gas Discrimination and Mapping in Emergency Response Scenarios Using a Mobile Robot with an Electronic Nose
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: An electronic nose uses controlled sampling and baseline updates to handle MOX drift while classifying and mapping gases.

sources.limits: Experiments used ethanol, propanol and acetone surrogates; results do not validate toxic-gas thresholds or arbitrary mixtures.
sources.design_implication: Log warm-up, baseline, airflow and exposure state; do not label raw sensor output as calibrated concentration.

sources.title: Combining Non Selective Gas Sensors on a Mobile Robot for Identification and Mapping of Multiple Chemical Compounds
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Sensor fusion combines concentration estimates and class probabilities to construct compound-specific mean and variance maps.

sources.limits: The authors do not quantitatively validate predictive map capability; pose uncertainty, drift and slow MOX recovery remain limitations.
sources.design_implication: Preserve class confidence and map uncertainty separately from concentration estimates.

sources.title: GADEN: A 3D Gas Dispersion Simulator for Mobile Robot Olfaction in Realistic Environments
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: A modular ROS simulator couples gas dispersion and sensor response; wind-tunnel comparisons examine spatial concentration behaviour.

sources.limits: Agreement is poorer in low-flow, turbulence-dominated conditions; robot-induced flow is not modelled.
sources.design_implication: Use simulation for reproducible algorithm tests while identifying missing physical effects.

sources.title: Information-Driven Gas Distribution Mapping for Autonomous Mobile Robots
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Information-driven gas mapping plans measurements using gas/wind estimates and uncertainty; results include simulation and physical wind-tunnel studies.

sources.limits: Figure 10 is simulation RMSE, not physical field accuracy; computation grows with planning horizon and map complexity.
sources.design_implication: Evaluate uncertainty reduction per path length and energy alongside raw spatial coverage.

sources.title: A Semantic-Based Gas Source Localization with a Mobile Robot Combining Vision and Chemical Sensing
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Vision-based object semantics guide chemical-source search through a decision model.

sources.limits: Safe surrogate chemicals replace hazardous target categories; physical source confirmation is assumed rather than experimentally validated.
sources.design_implication: Separate detection, contextual hypotheses and verified source confirmation.

sources.title: A Next-Best-Smell Approach for Remote Gas Detection with a Mobile Robot
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: A next-best-view-style strategy balances remote gas coverage, travel and sensing time in physical corridor trials.

sources.limits: The TDLAS system used methane in transparent bottles; quantitative source estimation is outside the reported scope.
sources.design_implication: Plan sensing time explicitly, but do not transfer remote-beam geometry to point MOX sensors.

sources.title: CARMA II: A ground vehicle for autonomous surveying of alpha, beta and gamma radiation
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Different behaviours address near-surface contamination avoidance and gamma dose-aware routing; sensor look-ahead and update timing constrain travel speed.

sources.limits: Experiments used simulated alpha and gamma sources; coverage avoidance is not proof of nuclear qualification.
sources.design_implication: Link sensor placement, latency and stop distance; keep dose and contamination concepts distinct.

sources.title: Robotic Exploration of an Unknown Nuclear Environment Using Radiation Informed Autonomous Navigation
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Layered radiation costmaps associate delayed detector readings with earlier robot poses and support recovery near high-cost regions.

sources.limits: Safe-MiniSource radiofrequency devices emulate gamma response; no calibrated gamma field was measured, and RF multipath affected maps.
sources.design_implication: Timestamp and latency-correct sensor measurements; validate the hazard model independently.

sources.title: Autonomous Exploration for Radioactive Hotspots Localization Taking Account of Sensor Limitations
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Detector field of view, angular resolution and acquisition stops affect exploration and coverage; simulation is compared with marXbot trials.

sources.limits: Physical trials emulate radioactive sources using infrared range-and-bearing signals; decision weights were manually chosen.
sources.design_implication: Measure dwell time and coverage uncertainty; do not infer radiation certification from navigation demonstrations.

sources.title: Autonomous Search of Radioactive Sources through Mobile Robots
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: A probabilistic source-search method combines Bayesian estimation and information-based action selection, tested in simulation and a real experiment.

sources.limits: The experiment is barrier-free; obstacle-rich and multiple-source extensions remain future work.
sources.design_implication: State geometry assumptions and count-statistical uncertainty in any proposed source estimator.

sources.title: A Behavioral Robotics Approach to Radiation Mapping Using Adaptive Sampling
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Adaptive sampling on a manipulator-equipped mobile platform addresses unreachable sampling targets and repeated motion/contact problems.

sources.limits: Seven trials and a small testbed do not establish broad reliability; contact triggers can include robot motion effects.
sources.design_implication: Log feasibility rejection, contact events and termination conditions, not only completed samples.

sources.title: Autonomous Water Quality Monitoring and Water Surface Cleaning for Unmanned Surface Vehicle
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: A surface vehicle combines positioned water monitoring, bottle sampling and surface collection; the sampling sequence flushes residual liquid.

sources.limits: USV results do not transfer to ground-rover mobility, and pH thresholding alone cannot establish water safety.
sources.design_implication: Specify rinse/blank procedures, sample identity, location and analysis limitations.

sources.title: Prototyping a low-cost open-source autonomous unmanned surface vehicle for real-time water quality monitoring and visualization
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: The open USV logs multiparameter water measurements locally and through cellular telemetry; mapping uses positioned observations.

sources.limits: Sensor cloud records lacked coordinates, so position was matched using external GPS timestamps in post-processing.
sources.design_implication: Synchronize environmental data, pose and time in a unified record at acquisition.

sources.title: ROMR: A ROS-based open-source mobile robot
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Published CAD, assembly, software and hardware information supports reproducing an open mobile platform.

sources.limits: Payload characterization is on flat ground and cannot establish uneven-terrain capability or Zephyron payload limits.
sources.design_implication: Publish interface drawings, bill of materials and reproducible test conditions.

sources.title: SMARTmBOT: A ROS2-based Low-cost and Open-source Mobile Robot Platform
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: A small ROS2 platform exposes camera and sensor topics and demonstrates repeatable builds and trajectory-control tasks.

sources.limits: Localization in evaluated control tasks uses external motion capture; this is a preprint, not evidence of standalone field autonomy.
sources.design_implication: Separate embedded sensing interfaces from the external infrastructure required by a demonstration.

sources.title: Enabling robustness to failure with modular field robots
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Steering-failure accommodation and module removal are examined in simulations and physical warehouse/leaf-litter trials.

sources.limits: Physical failed-module decoupling was manual; continued mobility has configuration and energy tradeoffs.
sources.design_implication: Design serviceability and degraded modes without describing manual repairs as autonomous self-repair.

sources.title: ResQbot: A Mobile Rescue Robot with Immersive Teleperception for Casualty Extraction
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication

claims.claim: Dummy-based casualty-loading trials compare viewing conditions using instrumented motion and task outcomes.

sources.limits: The study is not clinical human validation and does not establish casualty-handling capability for a small gripper rover.
sources.design_implication: Use instrumented surrogates and task-specific metrics for any intervention evaluation.

sources.title: LIO-SAM: Tightly-coupled Lidar Inertial Odometry via Smoothing and Mapping
sources.venue: 2020 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication
sources.reviewed_version: arXiv author manuscript of IROS paper

claims.claim: Factor-graph LiDAR–inertial estimation is evaluated with different platform datasets and loop-closure/GNSS configurations.

sources.limits: Reported performance depends on LiDAR, IMU, calibration, compute and scene conditions unavailable from a camera module alone.
sources.design_implication: Treat localization hardware and synchronization as requirements for a selected algorithm.

sources.title: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual–Inertial, and Multimap SLAM
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication
sources.reviewed_version: arXiv author manuscript of journal paper

claims.claim: Visual and visual–inertial configurations are benchmarked on EuRoC and TUM-VI with repeated-run trajectory-error evaluation.

sources.limits: Alignment conventions and sensor configuration matter; benchmark accuracy is not a Zephyron measurement.
sources.design_implication: Specify calibration, ground truth and trajectory-alignment rules before comparing localization methods.

sources.title: The Marathon 2: A Navigation System
sources.venue: 2020 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems
sources.review_scope: Targeted methods/results/conclusion reading; not exhaustive independent replication
sources.reviewed_version: arXiv author manuscript of IROS paper

claims.claim: Behaviour-tree navigation and recovery are exercised on repeated populated-campus waypoint routes with event and trajectory logging.

sources.limits: The paper evaluates its historical implementation and platforms; recoveries and interventions must be distinguished.
sources.design_implication: Report mission completion, recovery events, human interventions and travelled distance separately.
